payload.entry: QUALIFY CONTRACT for ci-evidence/release-wiring: `.github/release-qualification.json` schema_version=1 separates the Master Gate admission policy from release checks. Blocking qualification jobs are lint (command evidence) and test (3.12/3.13/3.14) (pytest evidence); the exercise entry names the existing four Linux/macOS wheel/sdist legs for `exercise_release`; visual-test, perf-floors, tutorial-tests, and ace-page-group-isolation are advisory. Each blocking CI entry requires completed `Write qualification evidence` and `Upload qualification evidence` job steps. `release_candidate qualify --manifest M --inventory I --jobs J --evidence-dir D --run-id R --attempt A --out O` reads normalized job-history schema_version=1: candidate identity, inventory_digest, workflow_run_id/current_attempt, and contiguous attempt snapshots with workflow_file, workflow_job_id, matrix, numeric job_id, exact job_name, workflow_run_id, execution_attempt, status, conclusion, URL, timestamps, step outcomes, and relative evidence_file. Each evidence binding carries repository, candidate_id, generation, checked_out_sha, expected_core_version, installed_core_version, inventory_digest, workflow_run_id, job_id, job_name, and attempt. Pytest evidence carries collected/passed/failed/errors/skipped, collection_failed, exit_status, first_failing_node_ids, and verbatim flaky_lines; command evidence carries completed step outcomes and missing_bindings/diagnostics, never pytest counts. `qualify` appends exact inventory bytes and loaded payloads before returning exit 2 on red; `evaluate` revalidates them and rejects bare pass, stale identity, and ambiguous history. Rerun eligibility is first-attempt test failures only; attempt 2 requires an all-test red first attempt, new evidence for rerun jobs, and unchanged proof for carried successes.

Added versioned N1 qualification inventory and candidate-bound evaluator/CLI; focused release-candidate tests passed (62 tests); sase tool run check passed including scoped tests (13m 51s); epic-symbols clear.

payload.entry:
CLI/JSON contract for qualification evidence (for release-wiring and later evaluators):

Plugin: opt-in only via PYTEST_ADDOPTS='-p tests._pytest_qualify_evidence' plus SASE_QUALIFY_EVIDENCE_PATH. Lives at tests/_pytest_qualify_evidence.py so CI does not set PYTHONPATH to the repo root. xdist workers are detected via config.workerinput (not inherited PYTEST_XDIST_WORKER). Nested pytest cannot overwrite the outer report (O_EXCL .owner claim). Session file kind=pytest_session schema_version=1 with collected/passed/failed/errors/skipped/collection_failed/exit_status/first_failing_node_ids/flaky_lines.

Writer: stdlib tools/write_qualification_evidence. Modes: --print-inventory-digest; --bind-manifest PATH --expected-core-version V --github-output FILE (writes candidate-id and generation, refuses core_version mismatch); --kind pytest|command --out PATH (writes identity-bound evidence). Payload filenames stay qualify-evidence-<job>.json; artifact names are qualify-evidence-lint-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }} and qualify-evidence-test-<py>-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}. Missing/unreadable pytest session => kind=pytest invalid=true with diagnostics (never fabricated green). Lint is kind=command with steps[] and missing_bindings[] parsed from check_sase_core_rs_bindings stderr. Binding fields: repository, candidate_id, generation, checked_out_sha, expected_core_version, installed_core_version, inventory_digest, workflow_run_id, job_id, job_name, attempt.

ci.yml: workflow_call inputs ref/core-source(default source)/core-version/manifest-artifact(default candidate-build)/probe-core-version. Concurrency qualify-<sha> cancel-in-progress=false when inputs.ref is set; ordinary CI keeps ci-<ref> cancellation. Use inputs.ref truthiness (inputs.ref != '' is true when inputs is null on pull_request). Test commands remain just test-cov / just test.

ci-evidence: reusable CI accepts ref/core-source/core-version/manifest-artifact/probe-core-version, pins qualify-<sha> without cancel, threads ref and expected-core-version, and writes identity-bound lint/test evidence on always() including invalid pytest when the session is missing. Opt-in plugin tests/_pytest_qualify_evidence.py plus stdlib tools/write_qualification_evidence; test commands stay just test-cov/just test. Verified: 79 focused tests under xdist including pass/fail/collection/zero/setup/nested/xdist/FLAKY/inherited-worker-env; sase tool run check 84e9332a35f3ad88e04302bbac168ba3 green; no --epic-symbol leftovers.

LANDING REVIEW at 54a9c14d2393ed168504eb64b2335b2e8fd1825e: read this epic, every child (.1-.4), every child note, the approved child and parent plans, and the four epic commits 443fba33d9 / 9edbacd4ef / 8afb1b7e57 / 54a9c14d23. Child PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entries: none. Inherited DECISIONS remain workflow steward, daily cadence, and memory changes reserved for the outer exit phase; no memory changes needed here. Reviewed intervening 5003ef69bd (core pin / steward adapter), de1d960d11 (deck presentation), 23cccbc969 (release fact reader), 112a5f4757 (health composition). The steward delegates to release_candidate evaluate, so preserve that shared contract and its candidate-gen observation asset-name filter. Remote master matches reviewed HEAD. No epic-symbol entries remain.

Remaining epic defects, reproduced from actual code: (1) ci.yml writer steps export no GITHUB_TOKEN and resolve_job_id matches unqualified lint/test names against prefixed reusable-call API names; both no-token and mocked qualify-ci / lint return None, making all evidence fail numeric identity. (2) release.yml uses nonexistent actions/runs/R/attempts/N/artifacts (live GET on run 39360520824 returned 404 while run-scoped artifacts returned 200); --paginate output is multiple JSON documents, but the zip downloader and collector accept one JSON document/list, so multi-page input raises Extra data. (3) draft attachment checks for candidate-genN-qualification-runR-attemptA.json but uploads qualification-observation.json, so the steward misses it and later attempts collide. (4) probe lint records installed version only from .venv, although failed preflight prevents setup; evaluator returns on binding mismatch before preserving missing_bindings in failure diagnostics (reproduced with required_binding). (5) a fetch-error red observation stores null workflow_run_id/current_attempt despite supplied expected run/attempt; re-evaluation rejects it as provenance disagreement instead of preserving typed QUALIFY_RED. Docs also overstate rerun eligibility as any failed blocker. These remain epic work, with executable workflow/producer-to-consumer regressions required; local phase contract passes did not exercise these seams. Live green/probe proofs are not yet present; listed release runs are older SHAs.

FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE: no child proposals to create, corroborate, or decline. A separately discovered pre-existing manifest core-source-pin/containment gap was processed through /sase_new_task; no duplicate task found, and a DISCOVERED ISSUE was attached to causal active outer epic sase-1n6 (exact-build/core-pin scope). No new task created. It is not silently counted as satisfied by a green qualification. A remaining-work child epic will serialize one bounded repair phase and a live-proof phase, because the approved acceptance requires exercising deployed workflow bytes after the repair is host-landed; a tale cannot wait on its own eventual commit. Keep this epic and phase sase-1n6.5 open until those proofs exist.
